riskMitigation.title: Mitigate Risk with Quensus
paragraphs: Founded in 2015, Quensus has rapidly evolved into a key industry leader, delivering bespoke, comprehensive solutions for leak detection and water risk mitigation.

Backed by over a decade of dedication and a team of highly qualified engineers, we’ve developed AI-powered cutting-edge technology that enables real-time water monitoring, instant leak alerts, and automatic shutoff.
By preventing leaks, we help avoid costly damage, conserve water, and cut water bills up to 60%. We help you create dry, leak-free spaces that improve living conditions and offer peace of mind.
